bucket_note: open, record-level, GPS 99.99%, KABCO; catch: no API (ASP.NET portal postbacks) and no licence text

sources.name: MN DPS MNCrash Public Crash Data Portal, Analyze Data (AdHocSearch) export
sources.access: open (web form, no login; CSV export by postback)
sources.licence_quote: No licence or terms on the portal (read 2026-11-08). The page says only: 'For technical assistance or access to complete public crash data sets, email: MNCrash.Team@state.mn.us'.
sources.street_names_note: one Roadway text field; 'X at Y' / 'X near Y' / 'X @ Y' street pair in 44.7% of 2024; a street alone in 55.3%; no house numbers
sources.keys_linkable: no person/vehicle tables in the public export (ACN crash key only)

placement_sample.note: TIGER-only network; auto = Gate() tiers with tiger_only_auto=True. 49.4% of Hennepin crashes name one street only; 17.9% of pairs say 'near' (not at the intersection, no distance), and freeway crashes place at the interchange, which pulls accuracy down. Every crash but 4 statewide has a point, so name placement only backs the corridor-street check.

end_to_end.corridor: Lake St (Hennepin CR 3), Lyndale Ave S to Portland Ave, Minneapolis (0.9 mi)

blockers: no licence text for paid use (public data under Minn. Stat. ch. 13, but no grant)
no person/vehicle data: pedestrian, bicycle, motorcycle and truck crashes can't be flagged
no collision type, light, weather or surface in the public export
portal is a web form, not an API: a portal redesign breaks the reader
no statewide average rates published; no Minnesota AADT in CrashIQ
user_actions: Optional: email MNCrash.Team@state.mn.us to ask (a) permission to use the public portal data in a paid product, (b) the 'complete public crash data sets' (with person/vehicle tables) the portal offers by email
Optional: MnDOT MnCMAT2 (agency login) has the full crash file; not used
